terms.def: One of the three paths on the map (top, mid, bot) where minions march. "Being in lane" means playing your path in the early game.
terms.ex: Stay in lane until level 6.

terms.def: The start of the game, roughly until the first towers fall: the laning phase.
terms.ex: Draven is very strong early.

terms.def: The middle of the game: lanes mix, teams fight over objectives.
terms.ex: In the mid game, follow your jungler to dragons.

terms.def: The end of the game: champions are maxed out and a single lost teamfight can cost the game.
terms.ex: Kassadin becomes a huge threat late game.

terms.def: Getting stronger over time, with levels and gold. A "scaling" champion is weak early but very strong late.
terms.ex: Farm calmly: you scale better than him.

terms.def: The moment your champion gets noticeably stronger: a key level (often 2, 3 or 6), a completed item, an ultimate coming up.
terms.ex: Level 6 is a power spike: look for the kill.

terms.def: Turning a small lead into a huge one: every kill gives gold, which helps win the next fight, and so on.
terms.ex: Samira snowballs fast if she wins lane.

terms.def: The most effective champions and strategies right now, depending on the patch.
terms.ex: He isn't meta right now, but he's still playable.

terms.def: A game update (about every two weeks) that changes champions, items or the map.
terms.ex: He got nerfed last patch.

terms.def: A nerf weakens a champion in a patch; a buff (patch-wise) makes it stronger.
terms.ex: Ahri got buffed, she's everywhere.

terms.def: The percentage of games won. For a champion, 50% is average; one point more or less is already a lot.
terms.ex: 51.9% win rate over 30 days.

terms.def: Pick: choose a champion. Ban: remove it from the game. Pick rate and ban rate show how often that happens.
terms.ex: He's banned so much you rarely see him.

terms.def: When the game puts you in a role you didn't pick, to balance the teams.
terms.ex: Autofilled support: spin the roulette for that role.

terms.def: Elo is your ranked level (Iron, Bronze, Silver…). LP (League Points) are what you gain or lose each ranked game.
terms.ex: +18 LP, Gold IV soon.

terms.def: The top lane role, usually fighters or tanks who spend a long time alone against their opponent.
terms.ex: Top can TP to join a fight.

terms.def: The role that farms monsters between the lanes, ganks lanes and controls neutral objectives.
terms.ex: Their jungler is top: play safe bot.

terms.def: The middle lane role, the shortest lane: mages and assassins who can quickly help other lanes.
terms.ex: Mid roamed bot, ping MIA.

terms.def: Attack Damage Carry: the bot lane marksman, fragile, dealing huge sustained damage late game.
terms.ex: Protect your ADC in teamfights.

terms.def: The role that goes with the ADC in bot lane: protection, CC, vision. Supports don't farm minions.
terms.ex: The support places control wards before dragon.

terms.def: The champion who deals most of the team's damage and has to "carry" the game. "Carry" is also a verb: winning the game almost alone.
terms.ex: Their carry is a Jinx, focus her.

terms.def: A carry that's very weak early but becomes almost unbeatable late if they've farmed.
terms.ex: Kog'Maw is a hypercarry: protect him.

terms.def: A very durable champion who soaks up damage and starts fights. "Tanky": able to take a lot of damage.
terms.ex: Their frontline has two tanks: go for their carries.

terms.def: A fragile champion who dies fast when caught (ADCs, mages, assassins).
terms.ex: Look for isolated squishies.

terms.def: A fighter that's both durable and dangerous, built for duels and melee brawls.
terms.ex: Darius is a bruiser who wins long fights.

terms.def: A very durable fighter, deadly up close, but slow and without mobility.
terms.ex: Keep your distance from a juggernaut.

terms.def: A mobile champion who kills a fragile target very fast, then gets out.
terms.ex: Zed looks for isolated mages.

terms.def: A champion who deals damage with abilities (magic damage), often from range.
terms.ex: Long-range bot lane mages bother Caitlyn.

terms.def: A support who heals, shields and buffs allies (Lulu, Janna, Soraka…).
terms.ex: Against an enchanter, favor short fights.

terms.def: A champion built to dive onto enemy carries, even behind their frontline (Camille, Vi, Jarvan IV…).
terms.ex: Two divers on their team: stay near your frontline.

terms.def: The durable champions in front during fights (tanks, bruisers) who protect the back of the team.
terms.ex: Stay behind your frontline.

terms.def: The back of the team in a fight: the fragile carries (ADCs, mages) the frontline protects.
terms.ex: Nocturne dives into their backline.

terms.def: A group of minions marching down a lane. Managing the wave well (pushing it, freezing it) is one of the game's basics.
terms.ex: Push the wave before you recall.

terms.def: Killing minions and monsters for gold. CS (creep score) counts how many you've killed.
terms.ex: Farm under your tower if you're struggling.

terms.def: Landing the killing blow on a minion: it's the only way to get its gold.
terms.ex: Poke your opponent when they walk up to last hit.

terms.def: Dealing damage from range, in small chunks, without committing to a real fight.
terms.ex: Poke with Q before you engage.

terms.def: A quick exchange of blows in lane: you hit, they hit back, both back off. A good trade means dealing more than you take.
terms.ex: Trade when their main ability is on cooldown.

terms.def: Throwing everything (abilities, ultimate, summoner spells) to kill the opponent, with no way back.
terms.ex: All-in at level 6 with your ultimate.

terms.def: Repeatedly poking the opponent so they can't farm in peace.
terms.ex: Harass them every time they step up.

terms.def: The ability to regain health while staying in lane (heals, lifesteal) without going back to base.
terms.ex: Against a champion with big sustain, poke isn't enough.

terms.def: Keeping the wave near your tower by only killing minions at the last moment: your opponent has to step up to farm, exposed to your jungler.
terms.ex: Freeze in front of your tower against a Nasus.

terms.def: Moving the wave toward the enemy tower by killing minions fast (fast push) or little by little to build a big wave (slow push).
terms.ex: Push, then roam mid.

terms.def: Sending a big wave into the enemy tower, which kills it: your opponent loses minions while you're free to move.
terms.ex: Crash the wave before dragon.

terms.def: Going back to base (B key) to heal and shop.
terms.ex: Recall when your wave crashes into their tower.

terms.def: Farming minions behind the enemy tower before they reach the lane. Singed is the specialist.
terms.ex: Proxy farm to force your opponent to move.

terms.def: Outer towers have plates early in the game: each one destroyed gives gold.
terms.ex: Tristana takes plates very fast with her E.

terms.def: Keeping your opponent away from minions with the threat of your abilities, so they lose gold and experience.
terms.ex: Caitlyn zones with her traps.

terms.def: Having lane priority: your wave is pushing, so you can leave your lane first (roam, help your jungler, objective).
terms.ex: Keep mid prio before dragon.

terms.def: Killing the jungle's monster camps. A full clear is every camp on your side before you gank.
terms.ex: Karthus has a very fast clear.

terms.def: When the jungler (or another player) shows up in a lane to gang up on the opponent.
terms.ex: Gank from level 3.

terms.def: Arriving during the enemy gank to turn it around.
terms.ex: Position to counter-gank bot.

terms.def: Going into the enemy jungle to steal their camps or attack their jungler.
terms.ex: You beat them early: invade.

terms.def: Regularly stealing camps in the enemy jungle to starve their jungler of gold and experience.
terms.ex: Kindred loves to counter-jungle.

terms.def: At the very start of the game, allies help the jungler kill their first camp.
terms.ex: Leash red buff, then go to lane.

terms.def: A group of neutral jungle monsters.
terms.ex: Save a camp for your jungler.

terms.def: Two big jungle monsters that grant a temporary bonus: blue helps with mana and cooldowns, red slows and burns the targets you hit.
terms.ex: Mid laners often take blue buff.

terms.def: The junglers' summoner spell: big damage to a monster, essential for securing objectives.
terms.ex: Save your Smite for dragon.

terms.def: The river crab: killing it gives gold and a zone of vision and speed.
terms.ex: Contest Scuttle with your mid laner.

terms.def: Anything that rewards the whole team: towers, dragons, grubs, Herald, Baron. Games are mostly won through them.
terms.ex: Play around objectives, not kills.

terms.def: Epic monster in the bottom river. Each dragon gives a permanent bonus to the team; four give the dragon soul. Later, the Elder Dragon appears with a decisive buff.
terms.ex: Place control wards before dragon.

terms.def: Small epic monsters in the top river early on: killing them helps your team take down towers.
terms.ex: Take the grubs with your top laner.

terms.def: Epic monster in the top river: once killed, it can be summoned to charge a tower and break it.
terms.ex: Drop Herald mid to open up the map.

terms.def: The biggest monster, in the top river from the mid game on: it gives the whole team a buff that empowers minions, perfect for breaking the enemy base.
terms.ex: Pick off a carry, then take Baron.

terms.def: Crowd Control: any effect that stops a champion from acting normally (stun, root, slow, knock-up, silence…).
terms.ex: Save your CC for their diver.

terms.def: The target can't do anything (move, attack or cast) for a short moment.
terms.ex: Annie stuns with her charged passive.

terms.def: The target can't move, but can still attack and cast.
terms.ex: Morgana roots for a long time with her Q.

terms.def: Reduced movement speed (sometimes attack speed too).
terms.ex: Ashe slows everything she hits.

terms.def: The target is launched into the air and loses control for a moment. Cleanse can't remove it.
terms.ex: Yasuo's ultimate needs a knock-up.

terms.def: Pushing a target back. Against a wall, some champions stun it too (Vayne, Poppy).
terms.ex: Knock the diver away from your ADC.

terms.def: The target can't cast abilities, but can still move and attack.
terms.ex: The silence cuts off their combo.

terms.def: The target is forced to attack whoever taunted it.
terms.ex: Rammus's taunt shuts down ADCs.

terms.def: The target walks helplessly toward the caster (Ahri, Seraphine, Evelynn).
terms.ex: A landed charm = a kill.

terms.def: The target runs away, out of control, for a moment.
terms.ex: Fiddlesticks fears with his W.

terms.def: The strongest CC: the target can't do anything while it lasts (Malzahar's or Warwick's ultimate).
terms.ex: Malzahar's ultimate suppresses its target for several seconds.

terms.def: The target's attacks miss for a moment (Teemo, Quinn).
terms.ex: Blind the ADC when they hit you.

terms.def: A quick movement over a short distance (lunge, leap). A blink is instant, like Flash.
terms.ex: He has no dash: he depends on his positioning.

terms.def: Starting the fight, often with CC or an ultimate. An "engage" champion is built for that.
terms.ex: Leona engages with her E.

terms.def: Stopping or breaking the enemy engage to get out without a fight.
terms.ex: Janna disengages everything with her ultimate.

terms.def: Protecting your carries by knocking back, slowing or blocking whoever attacks them.
terms.ex: Your job in teamfights: peel for your ADC.

terms.def: Attacking then stepping back between each attack, to keep your distance from a chasing enemy.
terms.ex: Kite the bruiser, he must never touch you.

terms.def: Attacking an enemy where they're protected: under their tower, or in the middle of their team to reach the backline.
terms.ex: Tower dive with your jungler at level 6.

terms.def: A lot of damage in very little time, often in a single combo.
terms.ex: LeBlanc bursts a target before it can react.

terms.def: Damage per second: steady damage dealt over time, as opposed to burst.
terms.ex: ADCs win long fights thanks to their DPS.

terms.def: Killing a target in a single hit or combo.
terms.ex: Veigar one-shots carries late game.

terms.def: An effect that instantly kills a target below a health threshold.
terms.ex: Pyke's ultimate executes low targets.

terms.def: Putting all of the team's attacks on a single target.
terms.ex: Focus their ADC as soon as the fight starts.

terms.def: A fight between (almost) both full teams, often around an objective.
terms.ex: Orianna wins teamfights with her ultimate.

terms.def: A small 2v2 or 3v3 fight, often in the jungle or river.
terms.ex: You win short skirmishes.

terms.def: Catching an isolated enemy and killing them before help arrives, often with long-range CC. (In draft: choosing a champion.)
terms.ex: Thresh creates picks with his hook.

terms.def: Chaining abilities and attacks in a precise order for maximum effect.
terms.ex: Combo: E then Q, then auto.

terms.def: A basic attack (right click), no ability.
terms.ex: Weave an auto between each ability.

terms.def: An ability that comes back off cooldown immediately, often after a kill (Katarina, Kha'Zix). Also: going back to base to come back at full health.
terms.ex: Every kill resets your abilities: keep going.

terms.def: A charge that builds up (passive, ability); "stacking" means building those charges. Example: Nasus's Q stacks.
terms.ex: Stack Q on minions all game.

terms.def: Turning a bad situation around through better execution (dodge, good timing).
terms.ex: He outplayed me with a perfect Flash.

terms.def: An item placed on the map that gives vision around it for a while.
terms.ex: Ward the river before you push.

terms.def: The (pink) Control Ward: it reveals and disables enemy wards around it. You can only have one out at a time.
terms.ex: Place a Control Ward in the dragon bush.

terms.def: The free item slot for vision: Stealth Ward (yellow), Oracle Lens that detects wards (red) or Farsight Alteration (blue).
terms.ex: Swap to the red lens in the mid game.

terms.def: Finding and destroying enemy wards with the Oracle Lens (red trinket) or a Control Ward.
terms.ex: Sweep the area before starting dragon.

terms.def: Tall grass: a champion inside is invisible to those outside (without vision).
terms.ex: Pyke waits in the bush for his harpoon.

terms.def: Walking into a bush without vision, at the risk of finding an enemy there. Avoid it.
terms.ex: Never face-check alone.

terms.def: What your team can see on the map. The rest is in the fog of war.
terms.ex: No vision: we don't go to dragon.

terms.def: Missing In Action: your opponent has left your lane and may be helping elsewhere. Warn your team with a ping.
terms.ex: Mid MIA, careful bot.

terms.def: Map-wide decisions (where to go, when to take an objective). Micro is your mechanical control of your champion.
terms.ex: He has good micro, but his macro is weak.

terms.def: Leaving your lane to help another lane or the jungle.
terms.ex: Push your wave, then roam bot.

terms.def: The top and bottom lanes in the mid and late game, where you farm or push away from the group.
terms.ex: Take the side lane waves.

terms.def: Pushing a side lane alone while your team is elsewhere, to force the enemy to send people.
terms.ex: Jax split pushes while the team holds mid.

terms.def: The rhythm of the game: having tempo means you can act first (objective, gank) while the enemy is busy.
terms.ex: A successful gank gives you tempo for dragon.

terms.def: Losing a game you were leading, through one or more big mistakes.
terms.ex: We threw at Baron.

terms.def: Turning a bad game around.
terms.ex: With their scaling, a comeback is possible.

terms.def: The gold bounty on a champion on a kill streak: killing them is worth a lot.
terms.ex: He has a big shutdown, focus him.

terms.def: Attack Damage: physical damage. An "AD" champion deals mostly physical damage; armor reduces it.
terms.ex: Their team is full AD: armor is enough.

terms.def: Ability Power: the strength of abilities, and by extension magic damage; magic resist reduces it.
terms.ex: Two AP mages on their team.

terms.def: Damage that completely ignores armor and magic resist.
terms.ex: Vayne deals true damage with her W.

terms.def: Damage based on a percentage of the target's health: very effective against tanks.
terms.ex: Her % health damage melts tanks.

terms.def: Critical strike: an attack that deals bonus damage. Many ADCs rely on crits.
terms.ex: Yasuo doubles his crit chance.

terms.def: An effect that applies with every attack that lands (bonus damage, poison…).
terms.ex: Kog'Maw lives off on-hit effects.

terms.def: Regaining health based on the damage you deal.
terms.ex: Aatrox heals a ton in fights.

terms.def: An effect that reduces the healing a target receives: essential against champions who heal a lot.
terms.ex: Ignite applies Grievous Wounds.

terms.def: Temporary health that absorbs damage before your real health bar.
terms.ex: Lulu shields her ADC at the right time.

terms.def: A heal. "Heal" is also a summoner spell (mostly for ADCs) that heals and speeds you up.
terms.ex: Save your Heal for the dive.

terms.def: The wait before you can cast an ability again. "It's on cooldown": it can't be cast again right away.
terms.ex: Engage when their E is on cooldown.

terms.def: The champion's most powerful ability (R key), unlocked at level 6, with a long cooldown.
terms.ex: Save your ultimate for the teamfight.

terms.def: The resource abilities consume. Some champions use energy (which regenerates fast) or nothing at all.
terms.ex: Out of mana: recall.

terms.def: A stat that reduces your abilities' cooldowns.
terms.ex: With lots of haste, you spam your abilities.

terms.def: Reduces the duration of the CC you take.
terms.ex: Against lots of CC, tenacity helps.

terms.def: The most played summoner spell: a short, instant teleport to escape or engage. Long cooldown.
terms.ex: He doesn't have Flash: time to gank.

terms.def: Teleport, a summoner spell: after a channel, teleports you to an allied tower (and other spots later on).
terms.ex: Top TPs bot for dragon.

terms.def: Summoner spell: true damage over time and Grievous Wounds on the target. Great for finishing a kill.
terms.ex: Ignite + combo at level 2.

terms.def: Summoner spell: slows the target and reduces its damage. Very strong against assassins.
terms.ex: Exhaust the Zed diving onto you.

terms.def: Summoner spell that removes most CC you're under (not knock-ups or suppressions).
terms.ex: Cleanse an Ahri charm.

terms.def: Summoner spell: a big movement speed boost for a few seconds.
terms.ex: Ghost to stick to ADCs.

terms.def: Summoner spell: a big shield for a few seconds.
terms.ex: Barrier to survive the burst.

terms.def: Good Game; WP: Well Played. Say it at the end of the game, without irony.
terms.ex: GG WP all.

terms.def: Forfeit: voting to surrender the game (possible after a certain time).
terms.ex: We don't FF, they scale worse.

terms.def: A game cancelled at the very start when a player never connected. It doesn't count.
terms.ex: Remake: nobody loses LP.

terms.def: Away From Keyboard: a player who left the game or stopped playing.
terms.ex: A loss with an AFK: LP loss reduced or prevented.

terms.def: Leaving champion select before the game starts (small penalty in ranked).
terms.ex: He dodged after seeing the comp.

terms.def: Dying a lot and giving the enemy loads of gold.
terms.ex: Stop going in alone, you're feeding.

terms.def: Dying on purpose or playing to make your team lose. Reportable.
terms.ex: He's been inting for 10 minutes, report.

terms.def: Being so annoyed or discouraged that you play badly. Best fix: take a break.
terms.ex: Three losses in a row, I'm tilted.

terms.def: Insulting or aggressively criticizing teammates in chat.
terms.ex: Don't flame your jungler, mute and play.

terms.def: Kill steal: taking the kill at the last moment when an ally did the work.
terms.ex: A KS is still a kill for the team.

terms.def: "Jungle diff", "top gap": the skill gap between two players in the same role, often said to taunt.
terms.ex: GG, jungle diff.

terms.def: A good player on a lower-ranked secondary account.
terms.ex: That Yasuo is a smurf, 15/0.

terms.def: One Trick Pony: a player who plays almost only one champion. Their "main" is their main champion.
terms.ex: He's a Riven OTP, don't let her snowball.

terms.def: A quick signal on the map (danger, on my way, enemy missing…). Also: your connection's latency.
terms.ex: Ping the enemy Flash when they use it.

terms.def: Noting when an objective, a buff or an enemy summoner spell (Flash) will be up again.
terms.ex: Dragon timer: 2 minutes.

terms.def: Short for "careful!": danger is coming.
terms.ex: Care, the jungler is coming.
